description: Append text to the end of a file, creating the file if it does not exist. The existing content is never changed or replaced. The text is appended exactly as given, with no newline added before or after it, so end it with a newline if the next append should start on a new line. Only works within allowed directories.

content.description: Text to append, exactly as given. No newline is added: end it with \n if the next append should start on a new line.

path.description: The file to append to; it is created if it does not exist. Absolute, or relative to an allowed directory; it must resolve inside the allowed directories.

name: append_file
title: Append File
